correctness.rationale: The uniformly selected parent has conditional depth P_n/n, leaf indicator L_n/n, and leaf-depth product Q_n/n. Expanding the growth updates cancels the two old-tree mixed covariance terms. A separate recurrence for E Q_n solves in closed harmonic form, leaving a constant covariance decrement -1/4 and deterministic base c_2=0. The exact-rational enumeration through n=10 independently checks the finite formulas.

value.rationale: Leaf abundance and total path length are two canonical global observables of recursive trees: fringe size and search cost. Their exact interaction is intrinsically motivated. The result identifies a size-uniform mechanism rather than a small numerical improvement: every insertion contributes exactly -1/4 to the covariance, and the induced least-squares slope tends to -3.
